summary: Export writes playable Agent meaning into DG 1.7.0 persisted fields and parks unrepresentable canonical fields in module flags. Semantic equality for other tools requires reading those flags or round-tripping through canonical.

losses.loss: DG 1.7.0 Agent system data cannot hold these fields. They are stored only in module flags. Raw Foundry JSON consumers that ignore the module will not see them; canonical interchange still carries them.
losses.remediation: Keep the module installed for Foundry-side Bio surfacing (ADR #0001); prefer canonical for cross-adapter transport.

losses.loss: Canonical SAN ≥ 100 is rewritten to POW×5 on write because Foundry prepare treats ≥100 as an init sentinel.
losses.remediation: Keep explicit SAN below 100 or accept POW×5 normalization.

losses.loss: Foundry only has violence/helplessness incident bits. other adaptations cannot be expressed in system.sanity.adaptations.
losses.remediation: Retain in canonical / flags; do not invent incident marks.

losses.loss: When incidentMarks is absent and adapted is true, export writes all three incidents true, losing which-incident history that was never specified.
losses.remediation: Prefer explicit incidentMarks in canonical when history matters.

losses.loss: Foundry stores disorders on motivation Items. Unlinked disorders become motivation Items with synthetic statement text.
losses.remediation: Link disorders to motivations in canonical when possible.

losses.loss: Plain/markdown becomes sanitized HTML on write; original format enum is not persisted by DG fields.
losses.remediation: Prefer HTML in canonical when targeting Foundry, or accept conversion.

losses.loss: Non-foundry extensions (for example greenAgentCreator workflow) are not written into the Actor. Cross-adapter meaning must already live in canonical fields.
losses.remediation: Ensure GAC→canonical mapped semantic fields before Foundry export.

losses.loss: Exported maxima follow DG formulas from stats; conflicting canonical maxima warn but do not force an anti-formula persisted max that prepare will overwrite.
losses.remediation: Align stats and maxima in canonical, or accept formula maxima in Foundry.

notLosses: Canonical Agent meaning that has a DG system or Item field is written there for other Foundry users.
Unarmed Combat custom skill round-trips to system.skills.unarmed_combat on this Foundry edge.
heavyMachinery writes the historical heavy_machiner key.
Impossible Landscapes fields write to system.corruption.
System-owned Unarmed Attack is bound/updated rather than duplicated.
Create-new leaves Foundry-owned presentation/access to system defaults; merge preserves them.
